design.trial_order: Alternate effort order by note; reverse in the next trial. Complete all three trials unless an operational/resource condition prevents it.
design.fixed: Exact source notes, prompt text, model, response schema, runner, binary, account, input normalization and isolation. No semantic retries.
design.context: Fresh process/thread/workdir per single-note call; existing subscription CLI; no web/tools; sequential.

review.standard: ../plan.json semantic_standard plus recorded corrections, including ../semantic-review-audit-v3.json. All existing validation criteria remain unchanged.
review.identity_hiding: Shuffle outputs behind opaque IDs. Save subject-level and full-note coverage judgments before revealing effort/trial identities. This reviewer's prior knowledge limits blinding.
review.targeted_context: Record D10 event context, D23 fee/mempool context, and D25 CEO context independently of calculation, metadata, source-gap and attribution problems.
review.allowed: Broad, nested, overlapping, duplicate subjects, plausible implications and supported alternative interpretations. No canonical subject list.
review.unresolved: Neither an established failure nor a pass; cannot supply an improvement contrast.

decision.primary_condition: At least two of D10/D23/D25 show the same specific context error in >=2/3 fresh low outputs and <=1/3 medium outputs, with affected meanings covered in all three medium outputs.
decision.overall_improvement: Primary condition plus more completely accepted note outputs, with no recurring new specific semantic regression. Report accepted-subject fractions but do not let correct duplicates compensate for errors.
decision.regression_guards: D19 source context and URL boundary; D24 attribution and source coverage; D28 negation/chronology without invented calculation. Review all other errors too.
decision.reject: No primary improvement or recurring new unsupported relationships, attribution changes, missing meanings or other specific regressions. Targeted improvement without better clean-output performance is a limited finding, not overall improvement.
decision.inconclusive: No repeated fresh low failure or unresolved decisive evidence. No automatic rerun.
decision.next_authority: This comparison does not authorize permanent medium adoption, prompt freezing or final validation. Report the decision and request direction if expanding scope.
decision.completion_boundary: Original full development and unseen final gates remain binding. ASv6.8 stays frozen; final data are unused.
